tool.howtobuild.circle.desc: A block-perfect circle: filled, outline or ring. Odd sizes have a 1×1 centre, even sizes a 2×2 centre.
tool.howtobuild.oval.desc: An ellipse with independent width and length, filled, outline or ring.
tool.howtobuild.square.desc: A square, filled, outline or ring, on the floor or on a wall.
tool.howtobuild.rectangle.desc: A rectangle with independent width and length, filled, outline or ring.
tool.howtobuild.cylinder.desc: A round or oval cylinder, solid or hollow, with optional caps; vertical or lying along X or Z.
tool.howtobuild.spiral.desc: A spiral staircase from any combination of blocks, slabs and stairs, with supports, trim, rails, columns and landings.
tool.howtobuild.sphere.desc: A sphere or ellipsoid, solid or hollow, with optional slices, openings and bands.
tool.howtobuild.dome.desc: A half-ellipsoid dome with optional floor, open top (oculus), cutaway and ribs.
tool.howtobuild.corridor.desc: A tunnel with an arch, dome or sphere cross-section, repeating arches and architectural details.
tool.howtobuild.mirror.desc: Mirrors the current shape exactly across X, Z or both, around the shape centre or a selected mirror centre, with an optional offset.
param.howtobuild.width.tooltip: Size along X (east–west), in blocks. For corridors: the inside-to-outside width of the tunnel.
param.howtobuild.length.tooltip: Size along Z (north–south), in blocks. For corridors: how far the tunnel runs.
param.howtobuild.thickness.tooltip: Wall thickness in blocks for rings and hollow shapes. Shells are built by erosion, so the thickness is exact everywhere.
param.howtobuild.fill.tooltip: Filled: every block inside. Outline: the one-block edge. Ring: an edge of the chosen thickness.
param.howtobuild.centre_size.tooltip: Automatic: 1×1 for odd sizes, 2×2 for even sizes. Forcing a centre that does not fit the size shows a warning instead of changing the size.
param.howtobuild.plane.tooltip: Floor: horizontal. Wall: vertical, facing north–south (rotate to face east–west).
param.howtobuild.style.tooltip: Filled: solid. Hollow: only a shell of the chosen thickness.
param.howtobuild.caps.tooltip: Close the hollow cylinder at the top, bottom or both.
param.howtobuild.orientation.tooltip: Vertical, or lying along the X or Z axis.
param.howtobuild.slice.tooltip: Keep only part of the sphere: top or bottom half, or the east or south half.
param.howtobuild.opening.tooltip: Cut an opening into a hollow sphere: at the top, bottom or side.
param.howtobuild.opening_size.tooltip: Diameter of the opening in blocks.
param.howtobuild.floor.tooltip: Add a floor (dome: a disc at the base; corridor: the walkway).
param.howtobuild.open_top.tooltip: Diameter of a round opening (oculus) at the top of the dome; 0 for none.
param.howtobuild.cutaway.tooltip: Cut away one quarter so you can see inside while planning.
param.howtobuild.stair_width.tooltip: How wide each step is, growing inward from the fixed outer boundary. The outer edge never moves.
param.howtobuild.revolutions.tooltip: Full turns. 0 with an extra angle makes a partial spiral.
param.howtobuild.extra_angle.tooltip: Degrees added after the full revolutions (e.g. 2 turns + 90°).
param.howtobuild.step_rise.tooltip: How many blocks each step climbs. More than 1 cannot be walked up without jumping (a warning is shown).
param.howtobuild.direction.tooltip: Which way the staircase turns while climbing, seen from above.
param.howtobuild.start_angle.tooltip: Where the first step is: 0° = south, 90° = west, 180° = north, 270° = east.
param.howtobuild.start_height.tooltip: Blocks above the centre where the first step starts.
param.howtobuild.main_step.tooltip: The block type of each step. Auto chooses from the selected material types: stairs, slabs or blocks.
param.howtobuild.support.tooltip: What holds each step up: blocks, slabs, stairs or none. Supports never go below the start height.
param.howtobuild.trim.tooltip: Edge trim along the outside of the steps.
param.howtobuild.support_depth.tooltip: How many blocks deep the support under each step is.
param.howtobuild.profile.tooltip: Cross-section of the tunnel: a round arch on straight walls, a dome or a full circle.
param.howtobuild.corridor_style.tooltip: Filled: solid. Hollow: walls of the chosen thickness with an air-filled tunnel. Shell: only the outer skin. Open: only the selected parts.
param.howtobuild.arch_interval.tooltip: A thicker arch frame every N blocks along the corridor.
detail.howtobuild.edge_trim.tooltip: Trim material on the outer edge.
detail.howtobuild.inner_ring.tooltip: A ring of trim on the inside edge.
detail.howtobuild.outer_ring.tooltip: A ring of trim on the outside edge.
detail.howtobuild.corner_accents.tooltip: Accent blocks on the corners / cardinal points.
detail.howtobuild.vertical_bands.tooltip: Vertical trim bands every N blocks around the shape.
detail.howtobuild.horizontal_bands.toolt: Horizontal trim bands every N blocks of height.
detail.howtobuild.smooth_curves.tooltip: Soften curved surfaces with stairs and slabs (uses the selected material types).
detail.howtobuild.top_rim.tooltip: A trim rim around the top edge.
detail.howtobuild.bottom_rim.tooltip: A trim rim around the bottom edge.
detail.howtobuild.longitude_rings.toolti: Meridian ribs from pole to pole.
detail.howtobuild.pole_caps.tooltip: Cap material at the top and bottom.
detail.howtobuild.cross_bands.tooltip: Two bands crossing over the top.
detail.howtobuild.segmentation.tooltip: Alternate materials in segments around the shape.
detail.howtobuild.radial_ribs.tooltip: Ribs running from the base to the top.
detail.howtobuild.crown.tooltip: A crown ring and finial at the top.
detail.howtobuild.outer_rail.tooltip: A railing along the outside of the steps.
detail.howtobuild.inner_rail.tooltip: A railing along the inside of the steps.
detail.howtobuild.support_pillars.toolti: Pillars from the ground up to the steps every N steps.
detail.howtobuild.central_column.tooltip: A solid column in the middle of the spiral.
detail.howtobuild.step_trim.tooltip: Trim material on the outer end of every step.
detail.howtobuild.landing.tooltip: A flat landing at the top.
detail.howtobuild.ring_support.tooltip: A support ring under every revolution.
detail.howtobuild.wall_attachment.toolti: Attach the steps to a surrounding wall.
detail.howtobuild.ribbing.tooltip: Ribs inside the tunnel every N blocks.
detail.howtobuild.arch_frames.tooltip: Thicker frame material on each repeating arch.
detail.howtobuild.keystone.tooltip: An accent keystone at the top of each arch.
detail.howtobuild.side_columns.tooltip: Columns along the walls at each arch.
detail.howtobuild.floor_border.tooltip: Trim along the edges of the floor.
detail.howtobuild.light_recesses.tooltip: Accent blocks in the walls, ready for lights.
detail.howtobuild.alternating_arches.too: Alternate materials on every other arch.
detail.howtobuild.entry_frame.tooltip: A frame around both ends of the corridor.
permission.howtobuild.available_throttle: Commands allowed, but you are not an operator: sending slowly (1 command every 1.25 s)
permission.howtobuild.no_permission: Command building unavailable: this server does not let you use /fill and /setblock. Copy or save the commands instead.
gui.howtobuild.title: How to Build
gui.howtobuild.favourite: Add or remove from favourites (favourites are listed first)
gui.howtobuild.mode.tooltip: Simple shows the essentials; Advanced shows every option.
gui.howtobuild.tab.details.tooltip: Trim, bands, ribs and other details
gui.howtobuild.material_types.tooltip: Which block types the shape may use. Combine Blocks, Slabs and Stairs freely; at least one stays selected.
gui.howtobuild.slab_mode.tooltip: Automatic picks bottom or top slabs to follow the shape; or force bottom, top or double slabs.
gui.howtobuild.rotation.tooltip: Rotate in 90° steps (the grid cannot represent other angles exactly).
gui.howtobuild.offset.tooltip: Center offset: moves the whole shape relative to the selected centre. The same for every tool; changing size or tool keeps it.
gui.howtobuild.align.tooltip: For even sizes the 2-wide centre extends from the selected block towards this side.
gui.howtobuild.lock_centre.tooltip: ON: Use my position centres on the block you stand in. OFF: even centres snap to the nearest block corner.
gui.howtobuild.materials.help: Click a slot to choose the full block, slab and stairs for each part. Choosing a full block also picks its slab and stairs when they exist.
gui.howtobuild.variation.tooltip: Deterministically mix in variant blocks (same seed, same result).
gui.howtobuild.variants.tooltip: Blocks mixed into the primary material by variation. Click a variant to remove it.
gui.howtobuild.seed.tooltip: Seed for variation; the same seed always gives the same blocks.
gui.howtobuild.pattern.tooltip: Stripes, checker, rings, bands or sections in the trim material.
gui.howtobuild.pattern_size.tooltip: Width of each stripe, square, ring or band.
gui.howtobuild.detail_preset.tooltip: None, Simple, Detailed, Architectural, Decorative, or Custom to choose each detail.
gui.howtobuild.detail_interval.tooltip: Spacing in blocks for repeating details (bands, ribs, pillars).
gui.howtobuild.labels.dimensions.tooltip: CAD-style dimension lines beside each section.
gui.howtobuild.labels.popups.tooltip: Floating labels for each connected section.
gui.howtobuild.labels.overall.tooltip: Width, length and height lines for the whole shape.
gui.howtobuild.labels.summary.tooltip: A label above the shape with the chosen components.
gui.howtobuild.labels.format.tooltip: Full (6 × 1), Simplified (6), Width only, Height only, Named (WIDTH: 6) or a custom template.
gui.howtobuild.labels.order.tooltip: Longest side first, or width then height.
gui.howtobuild.labels.units.tooltip: Suffix for numbers: none, " blocks" or " m".
gui.howtobuild.labels.decimals.tooltip: Decimals for non-whole values such as radii.
gui.howtobuild.labels.placement.tooltip: Where pop-ups sit relative to their section.
gui.howtobuild.labels.offset.tooltip: Distance between a pop-up and its section, in tenths of a block.
gui.howtobuild.labels.leaders.tooltip: Thin lines from pop-ups to their sections.
gui.howtobuild.labels.scaling.tooltip: Grow labels with distance so they stay readable.
gui.howtobuild.labels.billboard.tooltip: ON: labels turn towards you. OFF: they stay upright along their section.
gui.howtobuild.labels.through_walls.tool: Show labels and dimension lines through terrain.
gui.howtobuild.labels.distance.tooltip: Maximum distance in blocks at which labels are shown.
gui.howtobuild.labels.min_section.toolti: 3D shapes: only label sections at least this long.
gui.howtobuild.mirror.axis.tooltip: X mirrors east ↔ west, Z north ↔ south, X + Z both (four copies).
gui.howtobuild.mirror.mode.tooltip: Preview only shows the copy; Both builds original and copy; Replace builds only the copy.
gui.howtobuild.mirror.shape_centre.toolt: Mirror around the shape's own centre, or around a separately selected block.
gui.howtobuild.mirror.select.tooltip: Click a block in the world to use as the mirror centre.
gui.howtobuild.mirror.width.tooltip: 1-block centre: the plane passes through the middle of the block. 2-block: between two blocks.
gui.howtobuild.mirror.offset.tooltip: Shift the mirror plane by whole blocks.
gui.howtobuild.hologram.material_colours: Tint blocks with their material colour (otherwise a colour per part).
gui.howtobuild.hologram.centre.tooltip: Highlight the 1×1 or 2×2 centre with glowing blocks and a beam, visible through walls. Always shown while selecting a centre.
gui.howtobuild.build.method.tooltip: How you intend to build this.
gui.howtobuild.build.method.normal: Normal placement: build by hand following the hologram. Placed blocks turn green, wrong blocks red. Nothing is automated.
gui.howtobuild.build.method.commands: Command build: place everything with /fill and /setblock, only if the server already lets you use those commands.
gui.howtobuild.build.method.export: Export: generate the commands to copy or save as a .mcfunction file.
gui.howtobuild.build.progress.tooltip: Compare the hologram with the world and colour placed and conflicting blocks.
gui.howtobuild.build.per_tick.tooltip: Commands sent per game tick when you are an operator (default 2).
gui.howtobuild.build.keep.tooltip: Never replace existing blocks (uses fill … keep).
gui.howtobuild.build.max_fill.tooltip: Largest volume per /fill (vanilla limit: 32768). Bigger boxes are split.
gui.howtobuild.build.open.tooltip: Review, then execute, copy or save.
gui.howtobuild.build.title: Build
gui.howtobuild.build.blocks: Blocks: %s planned · %s already correct · %s to place
gui.howtobuild.build.mode_keep: Mode: keep existing blocks · max %s per fill
gui.howtobuild.build.mode_replace: Mode: replace existing blocks · max %s per fill
gui.howtobuild.build.warn_entities: %s of them have contents (chests, signs…) that undo cannot restore
gui.howtobuild.build.warn_unloaded: %s positions are in chunks you have not loaded
gui.howtobuild.build.warn_outside: %s blocks are outside the world's height and are skipped
gui.howtobuild.build.execute.tooltip: Send the commands to the server, a few per tick.
gui.howtobuild.build.confirm_hint: This replaces %s blocks. Click Confirm to build.
gui.howtobuild.build.copy.tooltip: Copy the commands to the clipboard.
gui.howtobuild.build.save.tooltip: Save as .mcfunction (plus an undo file) in howtobuild/exports.
gui.howtobuild.build.save_failed: Could not save the file (see the log)
gui.howtobuild.build.show_list.tooltip: Show the commands that would be sent.
gui.howtobuild.build.retry.tooltip: Re-send the commands of the last two seconds and continue.
gui.howtobuild.build.undo.tooltip: Restore the blocks that were there before the last command build.
gui.howtobuild.build.undo_hint: Undo restores the previous blocks. Click again to confirm.
gui.howtobuild.select_centre.tooltip: Click a block in the world to centre the shape there.
gui.howtobuild.use_position.tooltip: Centre the shape where you stand.
gui.howtobuild.clear.tooltip: Remove the hologram from this world.
gui.howtobuild.preview.tooltip: Show or hide the hologram. Preview never changes the world.
gui.howtobuild.build_button.tooltip: Open the build screen (nothing is changed until you confirm there).
gui.howtobuild.status.no_centre: No centre yet: press My position or Select centre.
gui.howtobuild.picker.title: Choose a block
gui.howtobuild.picker.heading: Choose a block for: %s
gui.howtobuild.picker.search.tooltip: Search by name, id, namespace (create:) or tag (#logs).
gui.howtobuild.picker.hint: Click a block to choose it.
gui.howtobuild.presets.title: Presets
gui.howtobuild.presets.name: Preset name
gui.howtobuild.presets.save.tooltip: Save the current settings under this name.
help.howtobuild.geometry: Choose a tool on the left and set its size. Every change updates the hologram immediately. Odd sizes have a 1×1 centre and even sizes a 2×2 centre; the Even centre options choose which way a 2-wide centre extends. Material types (Blocks, Slabs, Stairs) can be combined.
help.howtobuild.materials: Each part of a shape (primary, trim, steps, supports…) has its own block, slab and stairs. Slabs and stairs are checked by block type, so modded blocks work.
help.howtobuild.details: Presets add trim, bands, ribs, rails and other details suited to the tool. Choose Custom to pick details yourself.
help.howtobuild.labels: Labels are measured from the generated blocks. Sections are groups of blocks in straight runs or rectangles. Choose the format, what the summary shows and how labels look.
help.howtobuild.mirror: Mirroring is exact on the block grid. The mirror centre can be 1 block (plane through the block) or 2 blocks (plane between blocks) and can be offset.
help.howtobuild.build: Preview never changes the world. Normal placement: build by hand, with progress shown in green. Command build uses /fill and /setblock only when the server lets you; it asks for confirmation and can be undone.
help.howtobuild.general: Keys: H opens this screen, J selects the centre (left-click confirm, right-click cancel). Hover over any control for an explanation.
hud.howtobuild.help: Left-click: confirm · Right-click or J: cancel · Sneak: target block itself
hud.howtobuild.build_help: Open the build screen to pause, stop or undo
message.howtobuild.selecting: Selecting centre: left-click a block to confirm, right-click to cancel.
message.howtobuild.selecting_mirror: Selecting mirror centre: left-click a block to confirm, right-click to cancel.
param.howtobuild.follow_circle.tooltip: Build the staircase inside the exact footprint of a circle or oval (the same cells the Circle tool builds). Turning it on copies the Circle tool's size.
param.howtobuild.master_shape.tooltip: The shape whose footprint the staircase follows: Circle (one size) or Oval (width and length).
param.howtobuild.circle_width.tooltip: Master circle width along X, in blocks. The staircase's outermost blocks are exactly this circle's outermost blocks.
param.howtobuild.circle_length.tooltip: Master oval length along Z, in blocks.
param.howtobuild.inner_radius.tooltip: Radius of the open well in the middle. 0 = use the stair width: steps grow inward from the outer boundary by the stair width.
param.howtobuild.allow_outside.tooltip: Off (default): every block, including walls, rails and supports, stays inside the master footprint. On: a surrounding wall may sit one block outside it.
param.howtobuild.structure_part.tooltip: Walls, floor and columns. Auto: blocks, or slabs / stairs when blocks are not selected.
param.howtobuild.curve_part.tooltip: The curved part of the arch. Stairs follow the curve (upside-down underneath, upright on top); slabs take the matching half.
param.howtobuild.trim_part.tooltip: Arch frames, ribs and keystones. Auto: same as the structure.
gui.howtobuild.centre.base_layer: the centre's Y is the base layer
gui.howtobuild.centre.middle_layer: the centre's Y is the middle layer
gui.howtobuild.hologram.guides.tooltip: Draw the outline of the master circle a spiral follows, so any overflow would be obvious.
gui.howtobuild.debug.tooltip: Show the exact world bounds, size and centre on screen.
gui.howtobuild.debug.bounds: Min X %s · Max X %s · Min Z %s · Max Z %s · Y %s–%s
gui.howtobuild.circle.copy.tooltip: Use the Circle tool's size (or the Oval tool's, for an oval master) and follow it.
gui.howtobuild.circle.fit.tooltip: Follow the Circle tool's footprint, keep every detail inside it and make sure the steps fit.
help.howtobuild.center: The centre is the block you selected. Odd sizes have a 1×1 centre and even sizes a 2×2 centre; Even centre X/Z choose which way a 2-wide centre extends. The X / Y / Z offset moves the shape from the centre, the same way for every tool. For floor shapes, cylinders, domes, corridors and spirals the centre's Y is the lowest layer; nothing is built below it unless you set a negative Y offset.
param.howtobuild.diameter.tooltip: Exact footprint size in blocks, odd or even: 32 is exactly 32 × 32 with a 2×2 centre, 33 is exactly 33 × 33 with a 1×1 centre. Hidden while following a circle.
